resources.string: Everywhere else you stay a ghost. This chat may get:
Ghost mode is off right now, so this waits until you turn it on. This chat may get:
No favourites yet? Pick one from a chat\'s ⋮ menu.
Tap a chat to change or drop it. More live in each chat\'s ⋮ menu.
Chats that still get your receipts or typing. Picky, aren\'t we? Add them from a chat\'s ⋮ menu.
Ghost mode on. Poof, you\'re gone~
Ghost mode off. Everyone can see you again!
Still a ghost on this account
Only this account. Mark as read still sends a receipt, and reacting to a story still counts as a view. No cheating those!
Needs Stay offline. The server posts your message about 12 s later, so nobody catches you online.
Out in %1$d s. You stay invisible~
Only your screen changes. Everyone else still sees it all, so don\'t get cocky.
Matches incoming text and captions. Tap to edit, long-press to delete. You do know regex… right?
Gone from your groups. Add people from a message\'s long-press menu; tap to forgive them.
You forgot the pattern. Kinda important?
Forgive %1$s and show their messages again?
Erase everyone\'s activity log on this device? Can\'t undo that.
Notes when people go online, offline or read your messages, from updates Telegram already sends. Stays on this device… I\'m not judging.
Overrides \"%1$s\" just for this person. Special treatment, huh.
The activity log is off for this account. Turn it on in Hanako settings.
Just the latest %1$d. Don\'t be greedy.
Ghost mode isn\'t hiding story views here, so the author WILL see you in the viewers list.
Your view stays hidden. Reacting or replying still marks it seen, so hands off.
Kept on this device only. Tap one for the juicy details.
Clear every vanished chat for this account? No undo.
They wiped the whole chat. Rude!
Deleted, but I froze its reactions. No touching.
Nothing to hide? Lock one from a chat\'s ⋮ menu.
Unlock it? This chat will open without your fingerprint again.
Set up a fingerprint, face unlock or screen lock first.
No plugins yet. Import a manifest (.json) to start.
Tap to switch a plugin on or off, long-press for details or to delete it.
Import a plugin\'s .json manifest, plus its .dex/.jar for code plugins. New ones start switched off.
No jokes here: code plugins run unsandboxed with full access to your chats and accounts.
Seriously: code plugins can read and send messages, see your account data and make requests as you. Only allow plugins you built or fully trust.
This plugin runs code with full access to your chats and accounts. Only turn it on if you trust its author. Please?
Delete this plugin, its code and its saved data?
Couldn\'t make the image. Not my best moment.
Adds a button that turns selected messages into one pretty image. Made on this device. Yes, I\'m talented.
Shown under profile IDs. The registration date is my best guess and can be off by months.
This account only, even without ghost mode. Nobody sees your emoji taps or your sticker browsing.
I ask first, so clumsy fingers can\'t send or call. After Cancel, the recording waits in its preview.
That needs to be an https:// address
No answer (HTTP/2-only servers aren\'t supported). Using the default lookup.
Looks up proxy and backup server addresses through this server. If it flakes, I use the default.
Stuck for 10 s? I jump to the fastest saved proxy that works.
Goes direct while a VPN is up; your proxy comes back after. Tor is never bypassed.
All accounts. A VPN is on right now, so the proxy is skipped.
Signs or encrypts typed text in chats you pick (chat menu). Your keys stay in your OpenPGP app.
No OpenPGP app found. Install OpenKeychain, then try again.
Pick this chat\'s OpenPGP keys first. Nothing was sent.
Hold on, OpenPGP is still busy
Too long for one Telegram message once encrypted. Nothing was sent; shorten it.
The OpenPGP app gave back nothing usable
The OpenPGP app replied in a way I can\'t read
Warning: this message uses insecure encryption. Don\'t trust it.
Photos, videos and files rescued from deleted messages and view-once media. Kept on this device only.
Turn off the Telegram passcode first, then stealth mode.
Hidden accounts get their own 4-digit code. Type it at the passcode prompt and that account opens for this session.
Stealth mode hides accounts without the app passcode. Type a hidden account\'s code into chat search to open it. Clever, right?
You need the Telegram passcode or stealth mode before hiding accounts.

Only hidden accounts get an extra unlock code. At least one account must stay visible.\n\nThe code only guards the app. It is NOT encryption: anyone with full device access (root, backups, a compromised system) can still read your chats.
One signed-in account has to stay visible. You can\'t vanish completely.
This account will show up again in account switchers, settings and notifications. Coming out of hiding?
Enter the current unlock code before changing this account. I won\'t look.
Pick a separate 4-digit code, different from other hidden accounts and the app passcode. One you\'ll remember, please.
Another hidden account already uses this code. Copycat!
That\'s the app passcode. Pick a different code, or what\'s the point?
Nishishi, the codes don\'t match. Fingers slipped?
No UnifiedPush distributor app installed. Get one if you want push notifications.
Nope. Enter the gateway\'s VAPID public key, in base64url.

Google FCM only accepts a push signed with the key of the gateway it comes from, so this must be the VAPID public key of the gateway set above. Pushes go to %1$s. Change both together for your own gateway; leave them alone to use Mercurygram\'s.
This one matters: the default ntfy.sh server has tiny rate limits and blocks Mercurygram\'s push gateway. Push notifications won\'t work reliably.
Hanako already switched to: %1$s\n\nWant ntfy anyway? Use a self-hosted server.
No other distributors are installed, so UnifiedPush gets disabled. Install a compatible distributor with a self-hosted server to turn it back on.
⚠ The default ntfy.sh server is blocked, so push notifications won\'t work. Use a self-hosted ntfy server or another distributor.
These apply to every account on this device. Every. Single. One.
Unless marked otherwise, these only apply to this account.
No more update checks at startup. The button below still checks when you ask nicely.
Development snapshots through the updater. They may crash or be half done. Brave of you.
Pre-releases are development snapshots: crashes and half-done features included. You can switch back later. Continue?
Only the still photo of a Motion Photo goes out. Tap the motion icon when you want the live one.
The screen stays on near your face in calls and voice playback. Raise-to-listen stops working. Watch your cheek!
Hides Premium, Business and gift rows and banners. Unlocks nothing, sorry.
\"Delete for everyone\" comes pre-ticked. You can still untick it. Destroying evidence?
Search sticks to your own chats and contacts. The big scary public Telegram stays out.
Hides the AI button in the editors. It would send your draft to Telegram\'s AI. You have me.
Hides the AI Summary button. Summaries send the text to Telegram\'s AI. Just read it yourself?
No link previews while typing, so Telegram\'s servers never load your links.
Compose starts an end-to-end encrypted secret chat. Those don\'t sync to your other devices.
Swaps Roboto for your phone\'s fonts. Some screens need reopening first.
Counts the characters in your message, handy for groups with a length limit.
Deleted messages stay greyed out and old edits stay readable, media too. Nothing gets past me. Except secret chats.
Permanently delete ALL saved deleted and edited messages? This can\'t be undone.
With this off, Hanako gets no push notifications. Turn on Background Connection or Keep-Alive Service in Notifications and Sounds if you still want messages while the app is closed.
Android loves putting Hanako to sleep, and then notifications arrive late or not at all. An exemption fixes that. Blame the phone, not me!
New session key every hour instead of daily. Harder to track you, slightly more data.
Your session key will change every hour. Passive tracking gets harder, but it doesn\'t hide that you use Telegram. Continue?
The server refused the shorter key lifetime for: %1$s. Those accounts keep the 24h key. Toggle it off and on to retry.
Tor kept crashing, so I stopped restarting it. Toggle Tor off and on to retry.

Hanako will start built-in Tor and route Telegram\'s messaging traffic (MTProto) through it. Media and other HTTP traffic stay direct. The first start takes about 10–30 seconds, and Tor sleeps when the app is idle to save battery. Continue?
If your network blocks Tor (like in Russia or Iran), pick Snowflake: no setup needed. Have bridge lines from @GetBridgesBot? Pick obfs4. Direct is fastest where Tor isn\'t blocked.
Paste obfs4 bridge lines, one per line, from @GetBridgesBot on Telegram.
No valid obfs4 bridge found. Each line must start with \"obfs4\". Get bridges from @GetBridgesBot on Telegram.
Turn Tor off first if you want another proxy.
Couldn\'t download the Tor plugin. Check your connection and try again.
Tor plugin: signature mismatch — refusing to bind. Not risking it.
The Tor plugin is installed, but Android won\'t start it. Let it run in the background (autostart and battery settings), then try again.
The Tor plugin isn\'t available on this install channel. Sorry.
Pick how Hanako translates your messages.

Offline Translator (dev.davidv.translator) is the FOSS option: offline Bergamot models, translating quietly in the background. Until it\'s installed, translations use whatever fallback you allow below.
Offline Translator is installed. Open it once and download the language pairs you need.
If the offline translator comes back empty, use the Alternative HTTP path instead. The cloud is never a fallback when you picked offline for privacy.
Heads-up: bold, italic and code formatting may get lost offline.
Offline translation: no model for %1$s. Download it in Offline Translator.
Offline translation: I can\'t tell what language that is.
Offline translation: provider unavailable. Open or reinstall Offline Translator.
Whisper transcribes voice and video messages on your device. No Premium, no uploads. Needs a downloaded model.
\"Automatic\" lets the model guess the language. \"Device language\" or a fixed one pins it for every model, which helps since small models love guessing wrong on short messages.
Skips the silent bits before transcribing, so the model can\'t invent words out of nothing. Recommended, especially for small models. Uses a tiny extra model.
The models are open source (MIT). Download once or import a file you have. They stay on your device and run fully offline.
Your own emoji images instead of the built-in ones.
Draws emoji from your imported pack. Anything it\'s missing falls back to the built-in set.
Pick a .zip of emoji images, or an official Telegram APK to borrow its emoji from. The pack stays on your device and is never shared. Missing emoji fall back to the built-in set.
That\'s not a valid https:// URL.
Heads-up: the selected Mozhi instance handles your translations, and its operator may log them.
I strip utm_*, fbclid and friends from links you open, paste or share in. Sneaky trackers, begone.
Unsent drafts stay on this device, not on Telegram. Your half-written embarrassments are safe with me.
I show t.me and tg:// links before opening them, so no link can quietly join a channel or start a bot.

Only Hanako shows it, never sent to Telegram as a folder, so no folder or chat limit. Synced between your Hanako apps through one file in Saved Messages. Switching it moves an existing folder between Telegram and Hanako.
Sharing stopped when your device restarted. Open Hanako to resume it.
On a phone where you\'re already logged in, open Telegram, go to Settings > Devices and scan this code. Easy.
Ugh, something broke. Not my fault!
Your Telegram is too old for this. Please update it, it\'s ancient.
Too many tries! Slow down and try again later.
Ehh, the code expired while you dawdled. Log in again.
That phone number looks wrong. Check it and try again.
Slow Mode is on. One message at a time, okay?
Too many tries. Sit tight for %1$s.
No more Telegram ads for you. Happy?
**%s** only takes messages from contacts and Premium users. Picky!
%d story tucked away from your profile
%d stories tucked away from your profile
You can ask for an SMS in %1$d:%2$02d
You can ask for a call in %1$d:%2$02d
%d stories saved to your profile. Show-off.
Saved stories stay on your profile for everyone to see until you remove them.
You can\'t keep changing your birthday. You\'re not getting younger.
Delete this folder? You spent time sorting that!
You\'re up to date. So responsible ♡
This chat doesn\'t seem to exist. Typo?
That username won\'t work. Try another.
**%s**\'s stories moved to **Archive**. Out of sight~
You\'ll hear about every new story from **%s**. Fan much?
You changed this group\'s settings. Apply them?
This bot doesn\'t allow copying or forwarding.
Only your contacts can see your birthday. **Change >**
You changed this channel\'s settings. Apply them? Decide already!
The admins won\'t let you send media here. Ouch.
The admins blocked your media here until %1$s. What did you send them?
%1$s stops being an admin if you restrict them.
This emoji needs **Telegram Premium**. Some things cost money.
Slow Mode is on, so no more picks right now.
Ehh? This invite link expired. Too slow!
Invite link sent to **%1$s**. Off it goes.
No videos allowed in this group.
No photos allowed here either. Stingy group.
This person doesn\'t allow copying or forwarding.
Copying and forwarding is off in this group.
This channel doesn\'t allow copying or forwarding. Their loss.
You can\'t edit this message anymore. Too late~
Sticker packs stop jumping to the front every time you use one.
Delete %d story? It\'s gone for good.
Delete %d stories? They\'re gone for good.
Long press again for the debug menu
A contact joined Telegram. Company for you!
Waiting for %s to come online... where ARE they?
W-wait, you\'re actually deleting this photo?
New chats, groups and channels from strangers get archived and muted automatically.
Pfft, you\'re already logged in with this account here.
You joined %s. Fufu, no hesitation at all.
Someone already took that username. Too slow.
Get **Telegram Premium** and upload %d times faster. Tempted?
Unknown error: %s. Even I don\'t know that one.
Checklists can\'t go to secret chats.
Fufu, didn\'t know? Swipe left on any message to reply.
Stop the quiz now and nobody can vote anymore. This can\'t be undone.
Stop the poll now and nobody can vote anymore. This can\'t be undone.
Add a comment... make it smart.
Report sent. I\'ve got your back.
Public polls can\'t be forwarded to channels.
Birthday added. I\'ll pretend I didn\'t see the year.
Polls can\'t go to secret chats.
Let the video finish downloading first.
You can only add mutual contacts to groups right now. No spamming!
This media may contain sensitive content suitable only for adults.
This media may contain adults-only content. Still want to see it?
This group is full. No room for you, sorry.
Invoices can\'t go to secret chats.
You can only import into private chats with mutual contacts. No shortcuts!
Media isn\'t allowed in this group.
Checklists aren\'t allowed in this group.
The admins banned you from sending checklists here. What did you do?
Polls aren\'t allowed in this group.
The admins won\'t let you post polls here. Hmph.
You\'ll use this email every time you log in on a new device. Write it down, knowing you.
Choose who can see your birthday in **Settings.**
**Telegram Premium** makes downloads %d times faster. Just saying.
Wipe your search history? Hiding something, are we? ♡
This post was removed from the discussion group.
You can\'t send messages to this channel.

Bots can only be added as admins.
